paragraphs.source_en: The inspector did not say anything and led the way to the next cell. Again the door was unlocked, and all got up and stood silent. Again the Englishman gave away Testaments. It was the same in the fifth and sixth cells, in those to the right and those to the left.

units.source_en: The inspector did not say anything and led the way to the next cell.
Again the door was unlocked, and all got up and stood silent.
Again the Englishman gave away Testaments.
It was the same in the fifth and sixth cells, in those to the right and those to the left.

paragraphs.source_en: From those sentenced to hard labour they went on to the exiles.

units.source_en: From those sentenced to hard labour they went on to the exiles.

paragraphs.source_en: From the exiles to those evicted by the Commune and those who followed of their own free will.

units.source_en: From the exiles to those evicted by the Commune and those who followed of their own free will.

paragraphs.source_en: Everywhere men, cold, hungry, idle, infected, degraded, imprisoned, were shown off like wild beasts.

units.source_en: Everywhere men, cold, hungry, idle, infected, degraded, imprisoned, were shown off like wild beasts.

paragraphs.source_en: The Englishman, having given away the appointed number of Testaments, stopped giving any more, and made no speeches. The oppressing sight, and especially the stifling atmosphere, quelled even his energy, and he went from cell to cell, saying nothing but “All right” to the inspector’s remarks about what prisoners there were in each cell.

units.source_en: The Englishman, having given away the appointed number of Testaments, stopped giving any more, and made no speeches.

The oppressing sight, and especially the stifling atmosphere, quelled even his energy, and he went from cell to cell, saying nothing but “All right” to the inspector’s remarks about what prisoners there were in each cell.

paragraphs.source_en: Nekhludoff followed as in a dream, unable either to refuse to go on or to go away, and with the same feelings of weariness and hopelessness.
